---
title: "Examples from the help file"
subtitle: "The examples in help desctable, run in full"
---

The examples at the end of `help desctable`, run in order. Each call writes
an Excel file named by `filename()`; the tables for the first, second, and
fifth examples are shown on the [overview](index.html) page.

The default table: means (proportions for the binary and nominal
variables) and standard deviations.

```{.stata-run}
. sysuse nlsw88, clear
(NLSW, 1988 extract)

. desctable wage age i.race i.union i.collgrad tenure i.occupation hours, filename("descriptivesEX1"
> )
Sample size reported at the top of the table is # of total observations in the data.


The sample size varies across variables in the table due to missing data.
388 observations have some missing data on variables in the table.
 - Variables with missing data are:
    union tenure occupation hours 


Use the stat(n) option to show the # of non-missing obs for each variable.
Use the listwise option to exclude observations with any missing data.
..

Descriptive statistics table has been saved in the folder:
C:\Users\trent\stata\desctable

```

`stats()` selects the statistics and the order of their columns.

```{.stata-run}
. desctable wage age i.race i.union i.collgrad tenure i.occupation hours, filename("descriptivesEX2"
> ) stats(mean freq sd min max iqr median)
Sample size reported at the top of the table is # of total observations in the data.


The sample size varies across variables in the table due to missing data.
388 observations have some missing data on variables in the table.
 - Variables with missing data are:
    union tenure occupation hours 


Use the stat(n) option to show the # of non-missing obs for each variable.
Use the listwise option to exclude observations with any missing data.
.......

Descriptive statistics table has been saved in the folder:
C:\Users\trent\stata\desctable

```

`font()` and `fontsize()` change the typeface and size of everything in
the table (the defaults are Times New Roman, 11 point).

```{.stata-run}
. desctable wage age i.race i.union i.collgrad tenure i.occupation hours, filename("descriptivesEX3"
> ) font("Helvetica") fontsize(13)
Sample size reported at the top of the table is # of total observations in the data.


The sample size varies across variables in the table due to missing data.
388 observations have some missing data on variables in the table.
 - Variables with missing data are:
    union tenure occupation hours 


Use the stat(n) option to show the # of non-missing obs for each variable.
Use the listwise option to exclude observations with any missing data.
..

Descriptive statistics table has been saved in the folder:
C:\Users\trent\stata\desctable

```

`decimals()` sets the number of decimal places (the default is 2).

```{.stata-run}
. desctable wage age i.race i.union i.collgrad tenure i.occupation hours, filename("descriptivesEX4"
> ) decimals(3)
Sample size reported at the top of the table is # of total observations in the data.


The sample size varies across variables in the table due to missing data.
388 observations have some missing data on variables in the table.
 - Variables with missing data are:
    union tenure occupation hours 


Use the stat(n) option to show the # of non-missing obs for each variable.
Use the listwise option to exclude observations with any missing data.
..

Descriptive statistics table has been saved in the folder:
C:\Users\trent\stata\desctable

```

`group()` reports the statistics separately for each category of a nominal
grouping variable, side by side.

```{.stata-run}
. desctable wage age i.union i.collgrad tenure i.occupation hours, filename("descriptivesEX5") group
> (race)
Sample size reported at the top of the table is # of total observations in the data.


The sample size varies across variables in the table due to missing data.
388 observations have some missing data on variables in the table.
 - Variables with missing data are:
    union tenure occupation hours 


Use the stat(n) option to show the # of non-missing obs for each variable.
Use the listwise option to exclude observations with any missing data.
......

Descriptive statistics table has been saved in the folder:
C:\Users\trent\stata\desctable

```

`notes()` adds footnotes beneath the table; a long note can be split over
several quoted strings on separate lines of the command.

```{.stata-run}
. desctable wage age i.race i.union i.collgrad tenure i.occupation hours, ///
>     filename("descriptivesEX6") ///
>     notes("This is the first footnote." ///
>           "This is how to split long footnotes" ///
>           "onto multiple lines of the code.")
Sample size reported at the top of the table is # of total observations in the data.


The sample size varies across variables in the table due to missing data.
388 observations have some missing data on variables in the table.
 - Variables with missing data are:
    union tenure occupation hours 


Use the stat(n) option to show the # of non-missing obs for each variable.
Use the listwise option to exclude observations with any missing data.
..

Descriptive statistics table has been saved in the folder:
C:\Users\trent\stata\desctable

```
